B_968_auto_pass.verdict: PARTIAL — banner half PASS, chain auto-press NOT DRIVABLE ON THIS SUBSTRATE
evidence: MECHANICAL: the retired copy keys are absent from ALL SIX locales — grep -c 'turn_expired' => en:0 fr:0 de:0 es:0 ja:0 uk:0.
MECHANICAL: bun test packages/frontend/src/world-shell/fight_expiry_gate.test.js => 9 pass / 0 fail / 32 expect().
DRIVEN: a live simulator turn was left to run its clock down repeatedly — no banner text appeared anywhere on the surface at any point.

STRUCTURAL BLOCKER: FightControls.jsx:161 `const chain_backed = use_dungeon((s) => s.chain_backed !== false)` and :218-219 gate BOTH the auto-END-TURN and the stall console.error on chain_backed. simulator/fight_shim.js:223 seeds `chain_backed: false` DELIBERATELY (its own comment: 'The simulator's local sim stamps a turn deadline off its OWN wall clock, so the predicate alone would happily fire there — auto-passing the turn of a theorycrafter who is reading the board'). The expiry auto-press therefore CANNOT fire in the simulator, by construction. Driving it needs a chain-backed dungeon/world fight — i.e. SUI + a seeded on-chain character, explicitly excluded by this pass's own substrate ('Zero SUI, no wallet (simulator only)').

NOT THE SAME MECHANISM: the simulator DOES show an 'AUTO PASS IN 15S' cue and does auto-commit a drafted turn — that is turn_commit_countdown_s / auto_commit_label (the pre-existing commit cue), not the #921 expired-turn auto-advance. It was observed firing correctly and is not banner prose about deadlines.
TWO-SEAT SUB-BAR NOT RUN: it rides the same blocked mechanism.

C_964_receipt_truth.verdict: MIXED — trap drop PASS, status/pool persistence FAIL, snaptrap BLOCKED

utility_effects_fold_into_the_receipt_at.timeline: AP 6 -> 4 (cast cost 2) and MP 3 -> 4 (+1 MP utility buff applied) in the same receipt; entity carried TWO status chips, 'Become invisible · 3 turns' and '+1 MP · 3 turns', rendered on both the turn-order card and the entity hover card; the yajin's sprite vanished from the board (invisibility rendered).

trap_drop_survives_the_turn_cycle.detail: Fanged Snare (yajin_fanged_snare, tooltip 'EFFECTS — Places a trap — Earth damage', 2 AP, range 1-3) cast on cell ~(1020,420). AP 6 -> 4. After a manual END TURN and a full mob round the trap glyph is STILL painted on its cell (visible as the amber cell inside the green movement wash).

repro: 2. On turn 1 cast Vanish (yajin_shadowfold) on self.
3. Observe: 'Become invisible · 3 turns' + '+1 MP · 3 turns', AP 6->4, MP 3->4.
4. Press END TURN. Let the mob round resolve.
5. On the yajin's NEXT own turn: BOTH status chips are GONE from the turn-order card AND the entity hover card; MP is back to 3 (the +1 is not applied); the yajin's sprite is rendered again.
The spell cooldown DOES persist (socket 2 shows 11 -> 10 -> 9), so the cast itself is remembered — only the status/pool half is lost.
invisibility_and_MP_buff_persist_across_.why_this_is_not_legitimate_expiry: The chip declared 3 turns and was never once rendered at 2 or 1 — it went 3 -> absent in a single own-turn boundary. packages/sim/src/fight_actions.js:447 decrements durations via `update_entity(tick.state, entity_id, ...)`, i.e. only on the bearer's OWN turn, so one own-turn should have left 2 remaining.
invisibility_and_MP_buff_persist_across_.reproduced: twice, independently (first fight and a fresh second fight after STOP/START)

yajin_snaptrap_MP_on_step.verdict: BLOCKED — not castable in this build
yajin_snaptrap_MP_on_step.detail: The character was built at roster LEVEL 200 with Snaptrap invested to level 5 (spell budget 199 -> 149 across 5 spells). The armed fight deck contains only THREE spells — yajin_gutterknife, yajin_shadowfold, yajin_fanged_snare — and the turn-order card renders the seat as 'LV 1' while the roster panel renders 'LEVEL 200'. yajin_snaptrap never reaches a hotbar socket, so the MP-on-step payload cannot be driven. Additionally the mob AI never stepped onto the placed trap during observation, so no on-step trigger of any kind was observable.
yajin_snaptrap_MP_on_step.attribution: NOT introduced by any of the three PRs — none of 64f78787 / ec472b9c / ec53b090 / 13bde8a7 touch simulator/fight_start.js or class_deck_of. Pre-existing, but it is what blocks this acceptance item.
